PMID 27723228; quote verbatim. Dog hepato-preference held in human clamps (healthy men, T1D). Source is a sponsor overview; rule 2 prefers the primary clamp paper (Mudaliar 2016, dom.12753) as src; status unchanged.

PMID 34413118, quote verbatim. Same holds but dates to 2012: degludec's human clamp profile (Heise 2012, PMID 22594461; FDA 2015 SumR 'relatively flat at steady state') already matched the pig clamp. FDA 2026 SumR: icodec peak day 2, nadir day 7.

entries.note: Same bundle quote (PharmR 2457-2459). Opening untested at the 2006 proxy date.

entries.note: Same bundle quote (PharmR 2457-2459). Opening untested at the 2006 proxy date.

PMID 23043166; quote verbatim; registry 2015-11-13 confirmed; all five patient_trials registry dates match CT.gov. Earlier T2D HbA1c comparison exists: phase 2 Zinman 2011 (PMID 21396703, NCT00611884, degludec OD similar to glargine), so year 2011.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 6 (dating): same agreed; degludec's phase 2 T2D HbA1c result (Zinman 2011 Lancet, PMID 21396703, 2011-03) already matched, so the track's first same is 2011; BEGIN 2012 confirms without changing status.

entries.note: PharmR line 2543 verbatim (9.2% mitogenic potency vs human insulin; studies 205402-206632 undated in the review). Opening untested with the 2009 proxy.

SumR line 456 verbatim; the listed events (lines 451-455) include neoplasm-related AEs. Same on a predicted absence (#58: the assays made the null a prediction). Efsitora's 2026 numerical malignancy excess is unscored; see rule question.

PMID 27349219 (epub 2016-08-12), quote verbatim; model_src PMID 28421968 abstract reports standard clinical/morphological pathology with no liver finding; Cusi 2016 (PMID 27723227) confirms ALT +7 IU/L, higher LFC. Contra holds. Year 2017 vs epub 2016: see rule question.
PMID 27026683 (JPET, epub 2016-03-29); quote verbatim in abstract. Opening untested on the new STZ-rat track at the 2016 publication proxy (#112); IND-enabling characterisation, not a retrodiction.

PMID 24504686 (epub 2014-02-13); quote verbatim. Healthy-volunteer clamp admissible for engagement (decision 3); direction only. Trial predates the rat paper: dating falls under the open rule question on pairings whose model side published later.

PMID 36541037 (epub 2023-01-09); quote verbatim. Model_src PMID 35840338 (epub 2022-07-15, filed study DBT213) prospective; rat >=1 week vs human >=5 days fasting-glucose fall, direction only. No registry results for the phase 1; 2023 stands.
Same Owens 2016 abstract, quote verbatim; opening untested at the 2016 proxy. Rat states duration longer than lispro, no half-life or margin, so no magnitude.

Sinha 2014 quote verbatim; t1/2 24.4-45.5 h, flat profile. Rule 4 case 2 (#91 regimen): once-daily reached, IMAGINE 2 primary met (NCT01435616 results 2018-04-13 verified). No stated margin, so the ceiling is untested (decision 16); same stands.

Heise 2023 quote verbatim; off_by_2-5x verified (rat ~120 h, FDA 82-147 h; human ~17 d, IntegratedR line 1260). Entry carries registry_date 2022-11-02 (NCT04450394, verified), the earliest recorded date and the one the track's efficacy entry uses; rule 7 dates it 2022.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 6 (dating): year is the earliest public date, including registry results posting; NCT04450394 results posted 2022-11-02 showed the once-weekly regimen reached and tolerated, so same dates 2022, not Heise 2023.

entries.note: Owens 2016 quote verbatim; opening untested. Same source as engagement 5 and dose 3, correctly one model_id.

PMID 27349219 (epub 2016-08-12); quote verbatim; HbA1c primary non-inferior (margin 0.4%), endpoint_role primary. Registry 2018-04-13 verified. Rat published before the trial paper and trial started 2011-11, so prospective, not retro.

PMID 36944059; quote verbatim; HbA1c primary. Year 2022 by NCT04450394 results 2022-11-02 (verified), after Moyers 2022 (2022-07-15). QWINT-2 patient_trials quote verbatim in NEJM abstract (PMID 39254740), registry 2025-05-16 verified.
Owens 2016 quote verbatim; single-dose PK/PD paper states no harm prediction, so opening untested is right. Mitogenicity correctly left to insulin-mitogenicity-cells.

PMID 39270686; quote verbatim. Import from T1D is allowed (decision 12), but both sources attribute the excess to dose initiation/titration of a slowly adjustable insulin vs a titrated daily comparator (Lancet interpretation; IntegratedR 692-695, 824-827), conditions a single-dose rat never tested, so #35/#72 give untested with note. Normoglycaemic repeat-dose rats/dogs did show hypoglycaemia with mortality (IntegratedR 3518-3523): the harm belongs as a #23 same on rat-dog-chronic-tox, not a contra here.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4 (#35, #72): Lancet and FDA IntegratedR 692-695, 824-827 attribute the severe-hypoglycaemia excess to initiation/titration against a daily comparator, conditions the single-dose STZ rat never tested, so untested not contra; the harm belongs on rat-dog-chronic-tox (#23).

entries.note: 203313 PharmR lines 2457-2459 verbatim (Study 6UIR050902-100, Mar-2006, LYD pigs). Opening untested at the 2006 proxy; the clamp states no hypoglycaemia comparison.

PMID 23043166 abstract verbatim; overall confirmed hypo 1.52 vs 1.85 similar, nocturnal lower, so partial. SumR 707-709 verbatim, but it grounds the lower-hypoglycaemia premise in human phase 1 PK/PD; the pig clamp shows the same flat profile. DEVOTE 2017 would strengthen.

PMID 37356066 quote verbatim. No icodec lower-hypoglycaemia prediction is stated (inferred), and FDA 761326 SumR 182-184 blames a weekly day-2 peak; single-dose species t1/2 25-61 h vs 173 h human (PharmR 95-96) never tested that profile.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4 (#35, #72), as safety 6: FDA SumR attributes the excess to a weekly day-2 peak, a profile single-dose species (t1/2 25-61 h) never tested; no icodec hypoglycaemia prediction is quoted. Untested; track stays at 2012 same.

entries.rule: 4 dose rows (#91); a dose entry is not contra because a reached regimen did not work
entries.note: Gap fix rejected. Zinman 2013 (PMID 24622318) quote verbatim, but 3TW rested on human phase 2 (>42 h) and phase 1 PK/PD (SumR 698-712), not a pig/rat/dog-stated target; the regimen was given and failed HbA1c, efficacy's failure.

missing: Degludec three-times-weekly regimen: FDA 2015 SumR (bundle 203313 SumR lines 705-712) says the protracted flat profile 'led to Novo Nordisk's evaluation of ... three times a week (3TW) dosing' and 3TW 'is not being pursued'; both phase 3 trials failed non-inferiority (Zinman 2013, Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol, doi:10.1016/S2213-8587(13)70013-5, PMID 24622318; ETD 0.34% and 0.26%, more hypoglycaemia). Absent from dose, efficacy and patient_trials; candidate dose contra (regimen target too low, rule 4 row 7 / #91) dated 2013 on the novo-pig-clamp-rat-dog-pk track.

Efsitora's own model system (Lilly STZ-diabetic rat: single SC dose gives normoglycaemia for at least 1 week; in-vitro IR/IGF-1R and SAOS-2/H4IIE proliferation; Moyers 2022 JPET doi:10.1124/jpet.122.001105, PMID 35840338; FDA 761408 IntegratedR 2026, bundle lines 1125-1127 and 9719-9723, human t1/2 ~17 days line 1260) is mentioned only in the dose judgement; under decision 8 it is a separate track (e.g. lilly-stz-rat-weekly) with its own engagement/dose/efficacy entries (QWINT-2, NCT05362058, registry 2025-05-16).

Icodec's selection model (dog intravenous half-life screen with rat SC potency; Kjeldsen 2021 J Med Chem doi:10.1021/acs.jmedchem.1c00257, PMID 33944562) is cited only in the dose judgement; FDA 761326 PharmR line 92 also names diabetic rats and normoglycaemic dogs/pigs with unexplained cross-species potency differences (rat 50% of HI, dog/pig ~2x glargine, lines 93-94, 332-333).

Safety, hypoglycaemia on the Novo track (no safety entry exists for it): the pig clamp / sponsor claim of 'close to even distribution' of glucose lowering is contradicted by FDA 761326 SumR 2026 (bundle lines 184-186: 'peak glycemic response on day 2 and nadir on day 7 post-injection, resulting in higher level 2/3 hypoglycemia rates on days 2-4'; lines 442-443 'Rates of level 2/3 hypoglycemia were generally higher with insulin icodec'), an on-target harm measurable in normoglycaemic animals (761326 PharmR line 366). The 2024-07-10 CRL for T1D on 'an increased risk of hypoglycemia ... unfavorable benefit-risk' (SumR lines 211-216, ONWARDS 6) is importable with imported_from MONDO:0005147.

Safety, degludec hypoglycaemia: FDA 2015 SumR lines 707-709 states the flat profile 'might enable true once-daily coverage with a lower risk of hypoglycemia', a stated prediction that BEGIN Once Long met (Zinman 2012 abstract: lower nocturnal hypoglycaemia) and DEVOTE later confirmed; a candidate safety same on the pig-clamp track, currently absent.

Efsitora T1D safety (QWINT-5): severe hypoglycaemia 0.14 vs 0.04 events/patient-year vs degludec (Lilly press release 2024-09-10, https://investor.lilly.com/node/51336; Lancet, Sept 2024), importable with imported_from MONDO:0005147 and trial_unreported if only the release is cited; and the efsitora numerical malignancy excess (761408 IntegratedR lines 714-715, 812-821) on the mitogenicity track, recorded in judgement but not entered.

EX1000 is identifiable: a Novo Nordisk investigational insulin formulation tested in two 2008-09 phase 2 T2D trials in Brazil (NCT00698802 vs biphasic human insulin, NCT00660374 vs NPH; 8-week HbA1c primary), no results posted (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT00698802). It still scores nothing, but the context note 'could not be identified' should say this.

Efsitora hypoglycaemia on the rat-dog-chronic-tox track (no efsitora entry exists there): FDA 761408 IntegratedR lines 3518-3523 state repeat-dose findings 'were limited to exaggerated pharmacology (hypoglycemia) and its secondary effects in normoglycemic animals, including mortality and moribundity' (sponsor-dismissed animal signal); T1D patients confirmed severe hypoglycaemia 10% vs 3% (Bergenstal 2024, doi:10.1016/S0140-6736(24)01804-X, PMID 39270686; label 5.2 limitation of use). Candidate safety same under #23 dated 2024 with imported_from MONDO:0005147, which is where the harm should be counted once rather than as a contra on the STZ-rat track (CHECKER_BRIEF_v3 / models).
rule_questions: Regimen extension failure: when a model's protracted profile predicted both the filed once-daily regimen (worked, 2011-12) and an exploratory three-times-weekly regimen (failed phase 3 non-inferiority, 2013), is the dose cell contra on that track (rule 4 row 7 / #91, sticky under decision 6), or does the filed regimen govern with the 3TW failure recorded in patient_trials?

Dating a pairing whose model side was published after the trial (Davies 2016 epub Aug 2016; Byrd 2017 toxicology Jan 2017): is year the trial's epub year as rule 7 reads literally, or the year the pairing first became possible (2017, as drafted)?

A sponsor-authored overview that itself states the model-vs-human comparison (Jacober 2016): admissible as a comparison_stated source, or a review under rule 2 that must be replaced by the primary clamp paper, turning the entry into a pairing?

A predicted absence of harm (reduced in-vitro mitogenicity) met by a numerical malignancy excess the regulator attributes to pre-existing disease (efsitora, 1.4% vs 1.0%): does the regulator's attribution keep the track same, or is that drug untested with source_calls_it: unresolved?

Engagement in a clamp-readout class: the draft accepts T1D-patient clamps as dosed humans for the Lilly dog track (2016) but dates the Novo track's same to a T2D clamp (2021) rather than the 2012 T1D degludec clamps; the brief admits healthy volunteers but does not say whether patients of another disease count for engagement.

Single-dose PD model vs regimen-dependent on-target harm: when a PD model's own readout (blood glucose) is the harm's channel but the harm patients showed is an excess vs a titrated daily comparator that regulator and trial authors attribute to initiation/titration, is the model's silence 'askable' (safety contra, harm measurable in the species) or is it a failure under conditions the model never tested (#35, #72, untested)? Raised on the STZ-rat efsitora QWINT-5 entry (CHECKER_BRIEF_v3 / models).
